title: Doing the Works of Jesus and Greater Works
description: This sermon delves into the profound teachings of John 14:12-14, exploring the promises Jesus made to believers. It emphasizes the continuation of Jesus' works through all believers, the concept of doing greater works through the power of the Holy Spirit post-resurrection, and the significance of praying in Jesus' name. The sermon highlights the filters of praying for Jesus' fame, worth, payment on the cross, and sovereign wisdom, ensuring alignment with God's will.
